prior_finding_as_recorded.classification: Newly assessed current source finding conditional on capture component absence and required landing semantics; central owns exact alias and ledger disposition.
prior_finding_as_recorded.trace: The current capture query admits an optional LocomotionHeightState and substitutes HeightDistance::ZERO when it is absent. The landing gate obtains the maximum from all saved values and regards its final compression <=0.005 as settled. If earlier measured landing compression provides the required 0.04–0.08 peak while final height state is absent, that absent last observation is represented as zero and can satisfy the final settled predicate. In P17 the sample preserves absent compression and landing_response_valid rejects any landing frame missing that observation.
prior_finding_as_recorded.conditions: Requires the component to be absent at a selected landing frame, an otherwise present eligible subject/playback/route, at least one other measured frame satisfying the peak and knee gate, correct landing-sequence increment, and all other conditions for the landing predicate. Viewer lifecycle may maintain the component throughout; no actual absent component, passing report, live play or executed scenario is claimed. Other gates may reject independently.
prior_finding_as_recorded.future_repair_direction: Determine when height observation is required and carry missing versus measured-zero through capture and landing validation, preserving deliberate absent/nonapplicable modes and existing acceptance thresholds. Do not fabricate measured values or weaken acceptance.
relationships: 059 READ-L11-404 and READ-L12-823 documented P17 optional height fields but did not adjudicate this current inline landing chain. 774 SEGOVB-INITIAL04-CONTRACT-586 records that the P17 landing gate requires all compression observations; no retroactive claim of an old current-95e finding. q842/q845 and q1157 concern separate height/config/landing producer questions, not automatic aliases.

thirteen_lens_perspectives.bounded_assessment: 95e capture admits optional height state and collapses absence into zero; P17 landing frame observations preserve None and reject it for selected nonempty landing frames. The prior landing finding remains conditional; no normal missing state is established.

Landing result is joint evidence of event-span one, peak range, last settled compression and knee flexion at the chosen maximum sample; a numeric zero alone cannot prove the final observation existed. Empty landing set is separately an applicability decision.

P17 and 95e HTML are different exact objects; P17 landing_validation file is absent in both 6533 and 95e, whose validation logic is inline. Comparison is of snapshots and semantics, not proof of chronological regression or runtime behavior.
Fallible bone-name serialization and P17 measurement/unavailability formatting have explicit boundary semantics. No evidence here supports deriving away admission/error or observation handling.

P17 Observation distinguishes Measured, Unavailable and NotApplicable in display; empty selected scenario versus missing required measurement are different contracts. The current bare HeightDistance cannot express absence for landing compression.

HeightDistance and LandingSequence own distinct quantity and event concepts. HTML report serializes a named bone role at the boundary; avoid replacing semantic identities with string labels as internal authority.

P17 comparator total_cmp keeps the last equal peak; current maximum comparator and floating max are distinct operations. One wrapped event and selected sample knee are required, while unchecked availability substitution remains the proven conditional concern.

Both HTML variants use 64Hz timer; current scenario frames use selected locomotion sample rate. Related q1245 and prior timestamp finding are not automatic aliases; intended playback policy and admitted config remain open. Landing thresholds 0.04–0.08m, 0.005m and 10 degrees are existing review policy, not proof of defective numbers.

HTML attribute/text and inline script embed labels; 059 q1230 and prior current producer trace qualify this as an open boundary question. Unknown CLI choice ordinarily filters to empty and asserts; do not claim arbitrary input reaches browser or injection.

Current subject capture receives optional LocomotionHeightState, retains HeightDistance, and inline validation consumes it; procedural advance normally inserts missing component on success, rejects updates on error. Complete absence-after-peak lifecycle is not established.

Fixed HTML playback timer is a separate report presentation rate from scenario configured sample clock; whether deliberately independent is open. Landing compression source and missing-value surrogate must not become independent authorities. No new duplicate finding here.

Measured zero, unavailable observation, and not-applicable scenario are distinct; event span, bone angle and distance maintain different units and semantics. No stronger type merge/split finding follows from this scope.

Capture owns admission and retained availability, procedural state owns compression, landing validation owns selected applicability and gates, and HTML owns contextual encoding at the native output boundary; shared fix/alias decisions remain central.
